import json, os, stat
root='/app/submission'
entries=[]
for base,dirs,files in os.walk(root):
 for name in dirs+files:
  p=os.path.join(base,name)
  assert not stat.S_ISLNK(os.lstat(p).st_mode),p
 for name in files:
  p=os.path.join(base,name); st=os.lstat(p)
  assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1,p
  assert name.endswith(('.py','.json')),p
  entries.append((p,st.st_size))
assert len(entries)<=64 and sum(s for _,s in entries)<=2*1024*1024
assert json.load(open('/app/tmp/submission-final-check.json'))==json.load(open('/app/examples/basic.expected.json'))
print('submission files:',entries)
